from PIL import Image; import numpy as np
def load(n):
    im=np.asarray(Image.open('observations/obs_%04d.png'%n).convert('RGB')).astype(int)
    return im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
poses={170:(3.452,7.149),171:(3.452,6.399),172:(3.452,5.649)}
print('=== BROWN group1 per-column floor line (z=0) ===')
for n in sorted(poses):
    R,G,B=load(n); px,py=poses[n]
    br=((R-B)>40)&(R>60)&(R<140)&(G<80)&(G>25)&(B<60)
    lim={170:340,171:360,172:380}[n]
    print(' f%d pose(%.3f,%.3f)'%(n,px,py))
    for u in range(272,lim,8):
        i=np.where(br[:,u])[0]
        if len(i)<3: continue
        vb=int(i.max()); vt=int(i.min())
        if vb<=262: continue
        D=1.55*256.0/(vb-256); L=D*(u-256)/256.0
        z=1.55-D*(vt-256)/256.0
        print('   u%3d vt%3d vb%3d -> D=%.2f floor(%.2f,%.2f) ztop=%.2f'%(u,vt,vb,D,px-L,py-D,z))
print()
print('=== PALE neutral region (cabinet_1 tone R=G, R-B~5) top boundary ===')
for n in sorted(poses):
    R,G,B=load(n); px,py=poses[n]
    pale=(abs(R-G)<3)&((R-B)>3)&((R-B)<9)&(R>185)&(R<212)
    cols=np.where(pale.sum(axis=0)>20)[0]
    if len(cols)==0: print(' f%d none'%n); continue
    print(' f%d cols %d..%d'%(n,cols.min(),cols.max()))
    for u in range(cols.min(),cols.max()+1,16):
        i=np.where(pale[:,u])[0]
        if len(i)<5: continue
        vt=int(i.min())
        if vt<=262: continue
        D=1.55*256.0/(vt-256); L=D*(u-256)/256.0
        print('   u%3d vtop%3d ->(%.2f,%.2f) asfloor D=%.2f'%(u,vt,px-L,py-D,D))
" 2>/dev/null
